site.math.description: Kusukela ezingeni lamabanga aphansi kuya phezulu, funda ukucabanga ngezibalo okusebenzayo nokuxazulula izinkinga zangempela ngezinselelo ezijabulisayo.
site.english.description: Ngale kokulungiselela izivivinyo—funda isiNgisi esisebenzayo sezingxoxo zansuku zonke, ukukhula emsebenzini, ebhizinisini nasohambweni lomhlaba ngezinselelo ezimfushane.
site.korean.description: Kusukela kuhlamvu lwe-Hangul kuya esiKorea sebhizinisi, vula amathuba nobudlelwano obusha ngezifundo ezichazwe ngolimi lwakho.
landing.how1.title: Izinselelo ezimfushane
landing.how1.body: Imizuzu engu-3-10 ngesikhathi. Umqondo → isibonelo → izinkinga → inselelo, ukuze wakhe ukunqoba okuncane.
landing.how2.title: Zixazululele wena ngezinkomba
landing.how2.body: Kulungile ukuphosisa. Inkomba encane, inkomba enemininingwane, bese izinyathelo zikusiza kuze kube yilapho uqonda.
landing.how3.title: Bona ukukhula kwakho
landing.how3.body: I-XP, amazinga, uchungechunge lwezinsuku namapha wamakhono akho akhombisa ukuthi ukhule kangakanani namuhla.
landing.privacy: Asikucele igama lakho langempela, inombolo yocingo noma isikole. Isidlaliso nebanga lakho kwanele.

onboarding.nickname.hint: Ungasebenzisi igama lakho langempela. Isidlaliso esinezinhlamvu ezingu-2-16 sikahle.

locale.label: Ulimi
korean.official.note: Umaka owenziwe yi-AI ngokuqhathanisa isifundo ne-Korean Language Standard Curriculum esemthethweni (amazinga 1-6). Akusona isibuyekezo sothisha noma somkhulumi womdabu futhi akulona izinga le-TOPIK.
korean.official.pick: Khetha lapho uqala khona ngezinga elisemthethweni
korean.official.pick.hint: Khetha izinga lakho lamanje kumazinga asemthethweni 1-6 futhi sinconyela isifundo sokuqala. Usengashintsha isifundo ngezansi.
korean.official.none6: Asikabikho isifundo esikhethekile sezinga elisemthethweni 6. Sinconyela isifundo esiphezulu kakhulu.
modes.title: Khetha imodi yokubuyekeza
modes.intro: Buyekeza into efanayo ngezindlela ezahlukene. Imibuzo evela ezigabeni osuzifinyelele kuphela evelayo.
modes.listening.desc: Lalela umusho bese ukhetha ofanayo ezinketho.
modes.order.desc: Hlela izingcezu zamagama ngokulandelana okulungile. Ukulandelana kwamagama okunye okungokwemvelo kungalunga futhi.
modes.dictation.desc: Thayipha umusho owuzwayo njengoba unjalo. Ukupela kumele kube kulungile; esiNgisini, amalethazi amakhulu nezikhala ezengeziwe noma uphawu lokubhala kuyathethelelwa. Ukwehlukanisa amagama esiKorea akuthethelelwa.
modes.noSound: Uma ungakwazi ukuzwa umsindo, buyekeza nge-“Khetha ezinketho” noma “Hlela ngokulandelana”. Izilungiselelo zomsindo nosizo kuphrofayela yakho.
modes.cards.desc: Bona ingaphambili lelizwi, khumbula incazelo yalo, bese uhlola ingemuva. Lokhu akuthinti i-XP yakho, izinga noma uhlelo lokubuyekeza.
cards.local: Amamaka athi “Bengazi / Futhi” agcinwa kule divayisi kuphela futhi awashintshi i-XP noma uhlelo lwakho lokubuyekeza.
cards.done: Kuphelile! Bengazi izikhathi ezingu-{known}, futhi izikhathi ezingu-{again}.
tts.title: Izilungiselelo zezwi nomsindo
tts.voice.none: Alikho izwi lesi-{lang} elifakiwe kule divayisi.
tts.disclaimer: Izwi ledivayisi lifunda umbhalo kuphela. Alihloli ukubizwa kwakho kwamagama.
tts.help.title: Awukho umsindo, noma alikho izwi lesi-{lang}?
tts.help.check.volume: Khuphula ivolumu yemidiya, futhi ku-iPhone, vala imodi yokuthulisa.
tts.help.check.mute: Qiniseka ukuthi ithebhu yebhrawuza ayithulisiwe nokuthi umsindo awuya kusipikha se-Bluetooth ongasisebenzisi.
tts.help.check.browser: Amabhrawuza angaphakathi kwamanye ama-app angase angakhulumi. Vula leli khasi ebhrawuzeni evamile yefoni (Safari, Chrome, Edge).
tts.help.ios: iPhone / iPad: Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → Voices, khetha isi-{lang} bese ulanda izwi.
tts.help.android: Android: Settings → Language & input (noma General management) → Text-to-speech → voice data, bese ufaka isi-{lang}.
tts.help.windows: Windows: Settings → Time & language → Speech (noma Language & region) bese wengeza iphakheji lolimi lwesi-{lang} nezwi.
tts.help.mac: Mac: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → System Voice → Manage Voices, bese wengeza izwi lesi-{lang}.
tts.help.restart: Ngemva kokufaka, vala ibhrawuza ngokuphelele uphinde uyivule: izwi liyavela ohlwini.
tts.help.menus: Amagama emenyu ahluka kancane phakathi kwamadivayisi nezinguqulo.
tts.help.alt: Usengakwazi ukuziqeqesha ngaphandle kwezwi: xazulula ngombhalo nokubhalwa ngohlamvu lwesiLatini, noma uqale ngemibuzo engadingi msindo.
diag.intro.title: Ukuhlola ikhono kwemizuzu emi-2
diag.intro.body: Lokhu akuyona ivivinyo elinamamaka. Phendula imibuzo embalwa futhi sizothola lapho ukhona sivule indlela ekufanele. Uma ungayazi eyodwa, yeqe nje.
diag.result.title: Imephu yami yamakhono
diag.result.body: Le yindawo efanele yokuqala. Izinselelo zizogcwalisa izindawo zakho zokukhula!
dash.continue.review: Inselelo yokubuyekeza · kanye futhi ngaphambi kokuba ukhohlwe
dash.continue.done: Zonke izifundo ziqediwe! Ungathanda ukuqinisa amakhono akho abuthaka?
dash.coverage: Imibuzo engu-{served} kuphela kwengu-{total} etholakala kulolu limi kuze kube manje. Esele izovuleka lapho ukuhumusha kwayo sekulungile.
dash.skills.empty: Qedela izifundo ukuze ugcwalise imephu yamakhono akho.
dash.recent.empty: Xazulula inkinga yakho yokuqala ukuze uthole ibheji lakho lokuqala!
dash.diagnostic.cta: Thola indlela yakho ngokuhlola ikhono kwemizuzu emi-2
dash.guest: Okwamanje inqubekelaphambili yakho igcinwa kule divayisi kuphela. Bhalisa ukuze uqhubeke noma kuphi.

profile.deleteAccount.confirm: Uqinisekile ukuthi ufuna ukususa unomphela i-akhawunti yakho nayo yonke idatha yokufunda? Zonke izingqalasizinda zizosuswa ngokushesha futhi azikwazi ukubuyiswa.
profile.deleteAccount.done: I-akhawunti nayo yonke idatha kususwe unomphela.

pron.heading: Icebo lokubizwa kwamagama
pron.final: Ekupheleni kwegama noma ngaphambi komsindo oyisigxivizo, umsindo wokugcina oyisigxivizo esiqinile noma esiphefumulelwe, u-s, j noma ch (izinhlobo ze-k-, t-, p- nezimpinda) ubizwa njenge-k, t noma p evamile, isibonelo {ex}.
pron.liaison: Uma umsindo wokugcina owodwa noma emibili ulandelwa isizinzisi, isiphetho noma isijobelelo esiqala ngoqudu lwezwi (esibhalwe ngomsindo wokuqala ongezwakali), umsindo wokugcina ubizwa njengokuqala kwesilandiso esilandelayo, isibonelo {ex}.
pron.nasal: Umsindo wokugcina oyisigxivizo (uhlobo lwe-k, t noma p) uba umsindo wekhala (ng, n noma m) ngaphambi komsindo wekhala (n noma m), isibonelo {ex}.
pron.lateral: Uma umsindo we-n nomsindo we-l/r behlangana emngceleni wesilandiso, kuvame ukubizwa njenge-l (kukhona okuhlukile okumbalwa), isibonelo {ex}.
pron.tense: Ngemva komsindo wokugcina oyisigxivizo (uhlobo lwe-k, t noma p), umsindo olandelayo ovamile (uhlobo lwe-g, d, b, s noma j) ubizwa kanzima, isibonelo {ex}.
pron.source: Umthombo: Standard Pronunciation Rules of Korean, isigaba {art} (National Institute of Korean Language).
pron.note: Leli cebo lichaza umthetho. Izwi ledivayisi yakho lidlala umsindo kuphela; le app ayihloli ukubizwa kwakho kwamagama.
korean.band.title: Inqubekelaphambili ngezinga
korean.band.pick.hint: Khetha izinga eliseduze nelakho kakhulu (Isingeniso noma amazinga 1–5) futhi sizokuqalisa esifundweni esifanele. Ukuhlola ukubekwa okulandelayo kungeqa lokho osuvele ukwazi.
korean.band.preparing: Izinga 6 liyalungiswa futhi livuleka lapho okuqukethwe kwalo sekulungile.
korean.band.note: Lawa mamaka akhombisa izinjongo zokufunda. Akusona isitifiketi noma izinga le-TOPIK, futhi imiphumela yokufunda noma yokukhetha ayilinganisi ikhono lesiKorea lonke noma ukukhuluma.
think.hub.title: Izinselelo zokucabanga
think.hub.intro: Akuyona imibuzo enempendulo eyodwa: imisebenzi lapho ulinganisa ubufakazi, uqhathanisa, ulungisa amaphutha futhi wenza izibonelo zakho. Ihlukile ezifundweni ezivamile - zizame noma nini ufisa.
think.hub.notTranslated: Imisebenzi engakahunyushwa ngolimi lwakho ifihliwe futhi izovuleka lapho ukuhumusha kwayo sekulungile. Imisebenzi efihliwe
think.hub.koFirst.note: Kusukela ezingeni 4 imiyalelo isesiKorea. Ungakhombisa ulimi lwakho eduze kwayo.
profile.import.bad: Leli akulona ifayela lenqubekelaphambili yalesi sayithi.
profile.backup.hint: Inqubekelaphambili yokuhlola igcinwa kubhrawuza yale divayisi kuphela. Yigcine efayelini ngaphambi kokushintsha amadivayisi noma ukusula idatha yebhrawuza.
site.physics.description: Imisebenzi yokuhlola ifiziksi ewusizo ukuze uqonde imithetho yemishini, ugesi namandla.
site.chemistry.description: Imisebenzi yokuhlola ikhemistri ewusizo ukuze uqonde ukwakheka kwezinto, ukusabela namakhemikhali empilweni yansuku zonke.
